description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log entries, including priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and displays them in the UI, supporting chained logging via the LogNode interface.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode and displays log messages, formatting them based on priority and message content, supporting chainable logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats incoming log data and appends it to the LogView display, handling different log levels and exceptions, and ensuring thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
